Written 2026-08-23 after measuring that capture fidelity moved a full-frame number 47.86% -> 16.20% on one board with the product unchanged: the two things that did it are `buildrik_consent` (or a cookie banner sits across the bottom) and matching the board's SELECTION, since selecting an element opens a 300px inspector column the board may not draw. Both are handled by the runner, not by each recipe.
